process.label: Process

discovery.title: Needs and Operations Analysis
discovery.description: We plan the right infrastructure for you by examining your restaurant's table layout, kitchen workflow, and menu structure.

launch.title: Staff Training & Go-Live

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Things you might be wondering about digital menus and ordering systems.

delivery.question: How long does system installation take?
delivery.answer: A standalone QR menu setup is completed within 3-5 days. Full systems with table ordering, KDS, and payment integrations usually launch in 2-3 weeks.

pricing.question: How does pricing work?
pricing.answer: It varies based on the modules you need (menu only, ordering, KDS, etc.) and your number of branches. We work with a one-time setup fee and a business-friendly monthly license model.

revisions.question: Can I update prices and items myself?
revisions.answer: Absolutely. Through the highly simple admin panel we provide, you can add new items, change prices, or hide out-of-stock items in seconds.

maintenance.question: Does the system stop if the internet connection is lost?
maintenance.answer: Our system features offline caching support. Even if the internet drops momentarily, your customers can continue to view the basic menu on their devices.

migration.question: Will it integrate with the POS system I currently use?
migration.answer: We can integrate with many popular POS and ticketing software used in the industry. We analyze your current infrastructure and clearly inform you about the integration status.

mobile.question: Do customers have to download an app to order?
mobile.answer: No. The moment they scan the QR code with their smartphones, they access the menu and place orders directly through their browser, without needing to download any app.
